claims.statement: BornM2W (Witnesses.lean): 12 theorems notpd_0..notpd_11 of the form exists x, x != 0 and quad S x <= 0 for 12 explicit rational 6x6 matrices S (symmetrised stored decimals of 12 JARVIS-DFT entries, jid in each comment; 4 of them pass the incorrect linear orthorhombic criterion), and 6 pairs pd_k / pd_k_pivots for 6 further matrices: the LDL^T identity x^T S x = sum_k d_k (l_k . x)^2 with explicit rational d_k and unit lower-triangular L, and 0 < d_k for every k. quad C x = sum_i sum_j x_i C_ij x_j. The file now begins with a CC BY 4.0 attribution comment (correction C9) and was recompiled after that edit: rc 0, 24 axiom lines, each within the whitelist. These are statements about 18 explicit matrices; the step from the pd_k identity to positive definiteness (L unit lower-triangular) is not a Lean theorem. That the matrices equal the dataset's symmetrised tensors is a Python and hash step (Tier C), checked by the auditor by jid.

claims.statement: Mouhat and Coudert, Phys. Rev. B 90, 224104 (2014), arXiv:1410.0065: an unstressed crystal is elastically stable iff the quadratic form E = (1/2) V0 sum C_ij e_i e_j is positive for all e != 0, i.e. the 6x6 stiffness matrix C is positive definite (all eigenvalues > 0, equivalently all leading principal minors > 0); under load the relevant matrix is B, not C (Eq. 20); the closed-form class conditions (Eqs. 6, 9, 11, 13, 15, 18); Eq. 19 is the linear orthorhombic criterion of Wu et al., PRB 76, 054115 (2007), which they call incorrect; footnote 26 gives the counterexample C11 = 1/2, C22 = C33 = 1, C12 = -1, C13 = C23 = 0.

Dataset and licence. JARVIS-DFT 3D dataset (figshare article 6815699, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.6815699; version 11 is 10.6084/m9.figshare.6815699.v11), file jdft_3d-9-24-2025.json.zip; the unzipped json has sha256 9dacb55ac8371c7c2bf0332933b55c98e9cca6201e92eb9d6fcd03aab0975907 and the zip's md5 c3179161ef0d029cf1fa70da463aac6e equals the figshare API's computed_md5. Licence CC BY 4.0 (figshare API, read by the producer before download and again by the auditor). Attribution: Choudhary et al., npj Comput. Mater. 6, 173 (2020), arXiv:2007.01831; elastic-tensor workflow: Choudhary et al., Phys. Rev. B 98, 014107 (2018), arXiv:1804.01033. Stored units are GPa (the auditor matched five published values of Table S3 to the printed digits). The dataset is not redistributed here; at most 22 of its tensors appear in the shipped Lean and json files, with an attribution line.

Born and Huang, Dynamical Theory of Crystal Lattices (Oxford, 1954), as the source that Mouhat and Coudert cite for the positive-definiteness criterion. Not read by the producer or the auditor; the criterion is taken from Mouhat-Coudert 2014.

Headline counts. Of 93,902 records, 59,400 have elastic_tensor = 'na', 34,502 carry a 6x6 list, 179 of these hold NaN or infinity and are excluded: N = 34,323. Reading each stored float as the exact rational of its shortest decimal and testing S = (C + C^T)/2: 22,842 are positive definite and 11,481 (33.45 %) are not, each of the latter with an exact rational witness x != 0, x^T S x <= 0 (204 of them on the boundary: first non-positive pivot exactly 0). Three exact methods agree on every one of the 34,323 entries: the producer's LDL^T and Bareiss elimination over Fractions, and the auditor's strict sign alternation of the exact characteristic polynomial (own code). The auditor re-checked all 11,481 witnesses on its own S (x != 0, x^T S x <= 0, equal to the stored value) and found 0 mismatches over 34,323 entries and 10 fields. sympy leading minors on a 14,615-entry subset agree (0 mismatches). The auditor's code and per-entry output are not shipped.

Null tensors. 234 stored tensors are numerically zero (max |entry| < 1e-6; the largest below the cut is 6.8e-12 and the smallest above is 0.333), all NOT PD. Excluding them, 11,247 of 34,089 (32.99 %) are not PD (robustly not PD 11,225). 12 tensors have a literal zero row.

Rounding robustness (correction C1). Each printed value may vary within +-1/2 unit of its last printed place. Producer (Frobenius sufficient test): ROBUST_PD 22,708; ROBUST_NOT_PD 11,244; undecided 371. Auditor, exact Rohn (1994) vertex test over the 32 matrices S - T_z D T_z (z_1 = 1): ROBUST_PD 22,809; ROBUST_NOT_PD 11,244; certified truly ambiguous 55 (33 nominally PD, 22 nominally NOT PD); undecided 215, of which 210 are null tensors. With the half-width floored at 0.05: 22,809 / 11,216 / ambiguous 286 (33 PD + 253 NOT PD) / undecided 12. 33,399 tensors print every entry at 1 decimal; 874 tensors have an entry printed with more than 6 places.

The incorrect linear orthorhombic criterion (Mouhat-Coudert Eq. 19, applied to all entries regardless of class): 23,184 tensors pass it; 342 (1.00 % of N) pass it yet are exactly NOT PD (328 robustly); 0 fail it while PD (consistent with necessity). Class conditions: on the 30,203 entries to which a closed-form class condition applies, 555 disagree with exact PD of the full tensor (544 class-stable but not PD, 11 class-unstable but PD). Auditor's split of the 544 by block (correction C3): 184 have a Voigt diagonal entry <= 0, 299 a non-PD normal 3x3 block, 55 a non-PD shear block, 6 fail only through normal-shear couplings; 483 come from stored tensors that violate the class equalities the formulae assume, 61 from off-diagonal couplings. The VASP-to-Voigt permutation [0,1,2,4,5,3] was confirmed by the auditor (identity map would give 1,046 disagreements).

Controls, run and logged before any dataset number: positive (Cu, Si, diamond PD in exact, Bareiss and float; the footnote-26 tensor passes the incorrect linear criterion, fails exact PD, rational witness found; three known-unstable cubic tensors NOT PD); negative (sign flips of C11 and C44 flip the verdict; symmetry breaking detected; a singular tensor C11 = C12 is NOT PD and rounding-undecided; a tensor 0.1 GPa from the boundary is PD but undecided); random cross-check LDL^T vs Bareiss on 6,000 random rational matrices, sympy on 400. The producer log has 24 lines, every check PASS and ALL_CONTROLS_PASS True (logs/controls.json is the tracked record; the .log files are untracked and shipped as .log.txt copies, correction C8). The auditor ran 14 controls of its own (all PASS); it did not re-run the producer's controls.py.

Dataset observations, neutral (the owner has not forwarded these to the dataset authors): 59,400 records with elastic_tensor = 'na'; 179 tensors with NaN or infinity; 234 numerically zero tensors; 12 with a literal zero row; 922 not exactly symmetric (232 of them null tensors; 598 have max |C_ij - C_ji| > 1 GPa, median 19.5 GPa; for 7 the verdict depends on which triangle is mirrored); 874 with an entry printed with more than 6 places; 18 with an entry above 1e4 GPa, smallest float eigenvalue -6.3e5. Read-sanity (a positive control for reading the dataset): Voigt K and G recomputed from the tensor match the stored bulk_modulus_kv / shear_modulus_gv within 1 % for 97.9 % / 98.1 % of entries (median relative error 3e-5).

Provenance of the preregistration (correction C7): prereg_M2.json (sha256 2c3127f9...5d0fb) records written_utc 16:30Z, which is wrong; its file mtime is 16:22:52Z, before the dataset download (16:23:00Z) and all runs (16:24 to 16:37). The file was committed together with the results (051f87d), so git does not show the order; only the mtimes do. Outcome by the preregistered rule: KEEP. Deviations are logged in RESULT.md (sympy on a subset; post hoc additions; Lean limited to controls plus an 18-entry sample).

HEADLINE. Under the stated reading (every stored float taken as the exact rational of its shortest decimal; verdict for S = (C + C^T)/2; zero-stress Born criterion), 11,481 of the 34,323 finite 6x6 elastic tensors of JARVIS-DFT dft_3d (33.45 %; 32.99 % without the 234 null tensors) are not positive definite, each with an exact rational witness, by three exact methods and an independent AI audit. This is a statement about stored DFT tensors, not about materials: many entries are raw DFT outputs including hypothetical, unrelaxed and dynamically unstable structures, so a substantial fraction is expected; it does NOT say JARVIS-DFT is wrong and says nothing about any material being unstable in a laboratory. Finite-difference noise, residual stress, magnetism and convergence remain possible reasons for individual entries. Novelty: to our knowledge no exact-rational Born audit of the whole JARVIS elastic dataset has been published (not an exhaustive search). Filed C because the enumeration is not kernel-checked; Lean covers 18 explicit matrices only.

Float pipelines versus the exact verdict: numpy eigvalsh(S).min() > 0 disagrees with the exact verdict on 0 of 34,323 tensors; with absolute tolerance -1e-8 on 236 (all call a not-PD tensor stable; 234 are the null tensors); with relative tolerance -1e-6 * lambda_max on 3 (2 not null). Reproduced by the auditor with its own numpy call. Float verdicts are not evidence of anything about the exact verdict.

Context only, no association claimed: among entries with min_ir_mode a negative lowest IR mode is stored for 40 of 480 NOT-PD tensors (8.3 %) versus 221 of 2,959 PD tensors (7.5 %) (2 null tensors among the 480); NOT-PD fraction is 11.3 % (1,048 of 9,258) for entries with an ICSD id versus 41.1 % (10,199 of 24,831) without. The meaning of min_ir_mode was not verified. The ehull bins of the producer's RESULT.md (30.3 % vs 33.0 %) are WITHDRAWN (correction C2): the field was not verified to be an energy above hull (median 1.55, ICSD-linked median 1.46); the producer's JSON files still contain those bins.

NOT done or not verified: the binding anse/formal/lean_runner.py gate and a statement-lock entry for the Lean statements; the auditor did not re-run the producer's controls.py (it ran its own); Born-Huang 1954 not read; the physical meaning of the JARVIS fields ehull and min_ir_mode and the convergence state of individual calculations; Lean certificates for the other 11,469 unstable entries and for a larger stable sample (verified in Python only); repository guards antigravity_guard.py, test_rigor_guard.py and pytest tests/ were not run for this paper; no human audit. Recorded so the absences are explicit.
